_doc: Per-file char budgets for instructions/memory files (GHI #373). AGENTS.md was tightened 40k→15k by OBPI-0.0.54-01 as a moderate-compromise target; OBPI-0.0.54-03 measured a ~31k transitional floor with the current monolithic template (binding-rule corpus stays in AGENTS.md per shape (a) doctrine). The hard ceiling is Codex's 32768-byte project-doc cap: a per-turn budget above it would green-light a silently-truncated surface (enforced by tests.governance.test_agents_md_map_doctrine_obpi01/04 _budget_within_codex_cap). 2026-06-04: AGENTS.md budget held at the Codex cap 32768 — the un-compressed surface (32,483 chars) already fits with ~285 chars headroom, so no #519 emergency from the cap itself. OBPI-0.0.37-26's tighter 30000 interim relief target is DEFERRED to proper corpus/rendition execution (must come via a committed rendition played back deterministically, not a hand-edit of the rendered surface). The <15k destination remains GHI #533 / ADR-0.0.37 after corpus/rendition composition lands. CLAUDE.md 4000 and .claude/rules/*.md 15000 remain from OBPI-0.0.54.
